create_description: add a clamp(min, max, n) helper and use it in the volume setter
prompt: Add a `clamp(min, max, n)` helper in src/clamp.mjs that constrains `n` to the inclusive range [min, max], and wire it into `setVolume` in src/volume.mjs so volume stays within 0..100. `clamp` is currently a stub that throws. The regression command is `npm test`; it should fail before the work and pass after. Keep the change focused to the allowed files.
